source_name: Rojs, Peljhan, Prelesnik & partnerji — Banking and Finance practice / publications
why_relevant: Top-tier SI firm advising financial institutions on regulatory capital, restructurings, NPL sales and distressed assets; practice page is the entry point to its authored commentary and practice-guide contributions.

source_name: CMS Slovenia — Banking & Finance expertise and Law-Now alerts
why_relevant: CMS runs one of Europe's largest banking/finance regulatory practices with a Ljubljana office and a well-established alert machine (Law-Now / expert guides), routinely dating PSD3/PSR, DORA, MiCA and CRR/CRD milestones per jurisdiction.

source_name: Schoenherr — Banking & Financial Services Regulatory (Ljubljana office coverage)
why_relevant: Schoenherr's CEE-wide BFSR practice (Ljubljana office since 2001) publishes a high-volume regulatory roadmap/newsletter aimed at banks and fintechs; among the most deadline-explicit adviser sources for CEE payments regulation.

source_name: Wolf Theiss — Slovenia country page / Banking & Finance insights
why_relevant: CEE firm with Ljubljana presence covering banking, finance and regulatory; publishes client alerts and country-specific legal updates useful for cross-checking SI implementation timing.

source_name: Ketler & Partners (member of Karanovic) — banking, payment services and fintech regulatory practice
why_relevant: Explicitly ranked for financial-services regulatory and advisory work covering banking, payment services, fintech products, factoring, leasing and FX — the narrowest fit to this run's payments scope among SI firms. Chambers profile is the confirmed pointer; the firm's own alert channel still needs locating.

source_name: Andersen Slovenija — Novice / Davčne novičke
why_relevant: SI member of Andersen Global (Law Firm Senica joined in 2021); runs a dated Slovenian-language newsletter that systematically summarises FURS clarifications and regulatory document updates — the adviser-as-early-summariser pattern this cell targets. Verified items from Feb/Mar/Jun 2026.

source_name: Odvetniška družba Senica in partnerji
why_relevant: Established SI firm (founded 1986) with financial/corporate practice advising on banking and restructurings; Andersen Global member since Jan 2021, so its output partly flows through the Andersen SI newsletter. URL is the firm's expected domain and needs verification.

source_name: Šelih & partnerji, odvetniška družba
why_relevant: Full-service SI business law firm (tradition since 1961) consistently ranked in banking & finance; a standing candidate for client alerts on ZBan/ZPlaSSIED-level change. Domain inferred and unverified in this run.

source_name: Tax-Fin-Lex — Strokovni članki (professional legal articles) and news
why_relevant: Leading SI legal-tax portal aggregating expert commentary, legal reviews and consolidated texts of ZBan-3, ZPlaSSIED, ZPotK-2 and ZCKR, plus dated regulatory news items — the main place practitioner commentary on SI banking law is indexed and searchable.

source_name: Bančni vestnik (ZBS) — regulatory articles by practitioners
why_relevant: The SI banking journal carries practitioner and adviser bylines analysing regulatory change (e.g. a dedicated piece on ICT-risk regulatory changes ahead of DORA); a bridge between the advisory cell and industry-association commentary, with downloadable PDFs.

source_name: CEE Legal Matters — Slovenia section
why_relevant: Regional legal trade outlet that republishes SI firms' analyses and deal/regulatory news; the cheapest way to discover which SI firms are actively publishing on banking and payments and to snowball to their own alert channels.

source_name: Chambers Global Practice Guides — Banking & Finance: Slovenia
why_relevant: Annual SI chapter authored by a local firm: a structured, dated adviser summary of the SI banking/payments regulatory framework and pending reforms, and a reliable pointer to which firm currently owns this subject matter.

source_name: IFLR1000 — Slovenia jurisdiction review and firm rankings
why_relevant: Directory review naming the SI financial/banking legal market's active firms and teams; the fastest snowball for building and refreshing the adviser actor map behind this cell.

source_name: Odvetniška pisarna Bucik, Ljubljana
why_relevant: Smaller Ljubljana firm explicitly serving financial institutions; representative of the long tail of SI boutiques whose occasional sl-language client notes can surface practical compliance points the large firms skip.

source_name: iVarnost.si — DORA explainer for the financial sector
why_relevant: Non-law SI consultancy/media outlet producing sl-language DORA compliance commentary; useful as a cross-check on how SI practitioner audiences are being told to read ICT-resilience deadlines, and as a snowball into the SI cyber/compliance advisory community.

source_name: Finance.si — Banke in zavarovalnice (Časnik Finance, business daily)
why_relevant: Slovenia's only dedicated business daily; the densest sl-language reporting on Banka Slovenije supervisory measures, ZBan/ZPlaSSIED legislative drafts, MF consultations and industry pushback. Frequently first to name contested deadlines and to quote bank CEOs against draft rules.

source_name: Svet kapitala (Delo's business/finance vertical)
why_relevant: Delo's finance vertical covering banking, capital markets and regulation with analytical pieces; useful for framing of supervisory interventions and of EU-transposition debates (ZBan-4, instant payments, VoP).

source_name: Delo — Gospodarstvo (national daily of record)
why_relevant: Newspaper of record; covers parliamentary passage of banking legislation, ministry consultations and political friction over deadlines. Complements Finance with policy/political angle.

source_name: Dnevnik — Posel in denar
why_relevant: Second national daily with a business desk; covers consumer-facing payment/fee changes, ZPS complaints and supervisory controversies often absent from official channels.

source_name: STA — Slovenska tiskovna agencija (national news agency), economy/finance wire
why_relevant: Agency wire is the fastest neutral record of ministry consultations opening/closing, Banka Slovenije press conferences and parliamentary votes; most other sl outlets republish STA copy, so it is the upstream node for deadline timestamps.

source_name: Forbes Slovenija (N1 / United Media)
why_relevant: Verified sl-language coverage of Banka Slovenije financial-stability reporting and of draft legislation changing bank–consumer rules ('zakon, ki bi spremenil pravila igre za banke in potrošnike'), plus fintech/payments pieces. Free to read.

source_name: Necenzurirano.si — investigative portal
why_relevant: Investigative outlet that publishes bank/payment-sector stories official channels omit — e.g. a verified piece on Revolut blacklisting Slovenia and the correspondent-bank cause. Useful early warning on supervisory failures and de-risking.

source_name: RTV Slovenija — Gospodarstvo (public broadcaster, MMC)
why_relevant: Free, archived public-broadcaster economy desk; reliable dated record of regulatory announcements and consumer-payment rule changes, with strong searchable archive and no paywall.

source_name: Bloomberg Adria — Slovenian edition
why_relevant: Regional business-media newcomer covering Adria banking markets in sl; useful for cross-border comparison of supervisory and payments regulation across SI/HR/RS.

source_name: Bančni vestnik — ZBS banking & finance journal
why_relevant: The only Slovenian monthly journal for money and banking (since 1951, published by the bank association since 1967, EconLit-indexed). Practitioner/legal commentary on new supervisory rules and transposition — the trade-press core of this cell.

source_name: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije (ZPS) — consumer-side commentary quoted by media
why_relevant: Consumer association whose statements on bank fee increases and payment-service rules are routinely the news hook in sl media ('Preverite, ali se vam bančni paket še splača'). Reveals consumer-protection pressure that precedes regulatory action.

source_name: Regionalobala.si — regional news portal (consumer/banking pickups)
why_relevant: Example of the sl regional-portal layer that republishes STA/ZPS material openly and without a paywall — a practical free proxy for wire content otherwise gated at sta.si.
